verdict.line: You win this lane if you poke with ranged Q and reset before he closes distance; you lose it if you stand in extended trades and let Adrenaline Rush and Masochism heal him back and hit harder.

brief.thesis: Urgot is the only one with real ranged pressure in this lane — Mundo's one ranged tool, Q (Infected Cleaver), comes off cooldown every 4 seconds but still leaves him walking the rest of the way in on a melee kit. The matchup is decided by trade length: his passive (Adrenaline Rush) regenerates a percentage of his max health every second, and his E (Masochism) hands him bonus AD the lower his health drops, so short poke-and-reset patterns favor you while long stand-and-fight trades let him heal and swing back harder. That's the whole lane.

theirWindow.when: When Mundo is below half HP
theirWindow.what: Don't get baited into finishing him off in melee range — Masochism is actively giving him bonus AD for being low, and Adrenaline Rush is regenerating a chunk of that health back every second. Poke once, disengage, and let the drain happen from range instead of trading blows.

yourWindow.when: Right after Mundo throws Infected Cleaver
yourWindow.what: He has zero ranged answer for the next 4 seconds. Step up, land Q (Corrosive Charge) or auto-into-W (Purge) to trigger Echoing Flames, and use E (Disdain) to shove him off the wave if he's isolated.

start.why: 85.9% pick rate at a 50% win rate — the extra AD speeds up your auto+Q poke damage and the potion lets you keep pressuring Mundo without backing off to heal.

boots.why: Highest-performing boots at 50.9% win rate — Mundo's damage comes mostly from autos and Burning Agony's continual drain, and the bonus armor directly cuts his auto-attack trades once he closes distance.

core.why: Armor shred compounds across your auto+Q+W poke pattern and anchors the highest-pickrate build (45% win rate, 20% pick) as the first core item.
Gives you the health and tenacity to survive the moment he commits Burning Agony and Masochism together, so your own poke damage outlasts his all-in.
Completes the 20%-pick, 45% win-rate build path — stacking resistances scale directly against a bruiser trying to grind you down over a long fight.

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards exactly the poke pattern this lane wants — three hits mark Mundo and the next one deals bonus damage, punishing him for walking up into your range instead of using his own Q from distance.

summoners.why: 84.9% pick rate and the best win rate (53.2%) of the three options — Ignite's burn cuts directly into Adrenaline Rush's percent-health regen and Sadism's healing, taking away the exact tools Mundo needs to win an extended fight.

playing.title: Poke before he closes
playing.detail: Fire Q (Corrosive Charge) at its full 800 range while Mundo has no gap closer besides walking. Don't stand still long enough to eat his Q (Infected Cleaver) for free.

playing.title: Punish the Cleaver cooldown
playing.detail: After Mundo throws Q, you get 4 full seconds with zero ranged pressure from him. Step up, land auto-into-W (Purge) for the Echoing Flames proc, and follow with E (Disdain) if he's isolated.

playing.title: Hold E for isolation or escape
playing.detail: Disdain's 16-14s cooldown is long early, so don't burn it just to poke. Save it to displace him off the wave or to disengage once he commits to an all-in.

playing.title: Don't extend trades on a low-HP Mundo
playing.detail: Masochism scales his AD with missing health, and Adrenaline Rush keeps healing that health back. A drawn-out trade against a half-health Mundo can flip — reset instead of finishing it in melee.

playing.title: Time R around Sadism
playing.detail: His R (Sadism, 75s cooldown) sacrifices health for huge regen and speed. Your R (Fear Beyond Death, 100/85/70/70/70s cooldown, 2500 range) executes off a health threshold — burst him below it before Sadism comes up, or he out-sustains the execute.

playing.title: Build into the healing
playing.detail: Once Mundo starts stacking HP, pick up Executioner's Calling or Thornmail. Both his passive and Sadism regenerate percent-health, and grievous wounds cuts both directly.

playing.title: Abuse maxed W uptime
playing.detail: W (Purge) cooldown drops all the way to 0 seconds at rank 5. Once it's maxed, hold it active whenever Mundo is in range to chain Echoing Flames procs through extended skirmishes.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and win rates above are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning — why the poke pattern, trade timing, and item spikes matter — is my own read of the kits.
